Maharashtra Reports Over 6,100 TB Cases, Thousands of Villages High-Risk

Maharashtra has detected over 6,100 new tuberculosis (TB) cases within a 35-day period. During this time, 11,091 villages across the state have been identified and flagged as high-risk areas for the disease. This data highlights a significant public health concern regarding TB prevalence in the region.
